questions.stem: What is the role of the uterus lining (endometrium) in reproduction?

options.text: It produces the hormones needed for ovulation
It produces egg cells each month
It filters waste products from the blood
It provides a blood-rich lining where a fertilised egg can implant and develop

questions.explanation: The endometrium (uterus lining) thickens each month with a rich blood supply, ready for a fertilised egg to implant. If no fertilisation occurs, the lining breaks down during menstruation.
